buddy-buddy-plugin-buddy.description: Deploy apps to Buddy sandboxes, publish artifacts, create tunnels, manage domains, configure distributions, and run CI/CD pipelines using `bdy` CLI. Triggers on: deploy, sandbox, tunnel, expose, artifact, static site, publish, domain, distribution, pipeline, CI/CD. Also for looking at a pull request without acting on it: show / open PR #N, list PRs, what changed in a PR. Reviewing a PR → pr-review skill; opening one or fixing review comments → pr-author skill.

buddy-buddy-plugin-pr-author.description: Act as the author of a Buddy pull request: open a PR from the current branch with `bdy pr create` (optionally after making and committing the change), or address review feedback – fix the code, push, and answer and resolve the review threads. Use when the user asks to open, create or "załóż" a pull request, to make a change and open a PR with it, or to fix / respond to review comments on their PR. Not for reviewing a PR (use pr-review) or only showing one (use the buddy skill).

buddy-buddy-plugin-pr-review.description: Review a Buddy pull request with `bdy pr`: read the changed files, open threads on the exact lines, verify the author's fixes on re-review and give a verdict. Use when the user asks to review, check, go through or give feedback on a pull request ("review PR #123", "sprawdź PR #123", "przejrzyj pull 132"), or to re-review it after the author's changes. Not for only showing a PR or what changed in it (use the buddy skill), creating a PR or fixing review comments (use pr-author).
